name: Data.heightLe_volume_ratio_sq
summary: 𝔷 = |c|^D ∏ λ_j: the lift ratios have height ≤ D(log b𝓑 − h_main), the constants ≤ 2 log b𝓑.

steps.claim: From `Data.volume_iota_eq_prod_liftVolume`: constants c(ϑ) that cost m·m squares (const) with 𝔷_D(ϑ) = |c(ϑ)|^(dim rows(D))·∏_{j=1}^{m} λ_j(ϑ) for every m-fold twist ϑ (vol).
steps.lean: choose c const _ vol using D.volume_iota_eq_prod_liftVolume

steps.claim: lifts: ι ↦ ∏_{j=1}^{m} λ_j(1)/λ_j(θ_ι) has height at most dim rows(D)·(log b_D·𝓑(D) − h_main(D)): each factor has height ≤ dim rows·k·(log b·B₀ − 𝖴) (`Data.heightLe_liftVolume_ratio`, θ fit), heights add over the m factors (`HeightLe.prod`), and m·k·B₀ = 𝓑(D), m·k·𝖴 = h_main(D).
steps.lean:
have lifts : HeightLe (D.rowDim * (D.logB * D.budget - D.mainHeight))
      (∏ j ∈ Icc 1 D.m, fun ι ↦ D.liftVolume 1 j / D.liftVolume (θ ι) j) := (HeightLe.prod
    fun j h ↦ by exact heightLe_liftVolume_ratio o ⟨j, mem_Icc.1 h⟩).mono
    (by simp [mainHeight]; field_simp [(HasLogBound.pos D).ne']; rfl) fun _ ↦ le_rfl
steps.typed_fact:
HeightLe (D.rowDim * (D.logB * D.budget - D.mainHeight))
      (∏ j ∈ Icc 1 D.m, fun ι ↦ D.liftVolume 1 j / D.liftVolume (θ ι) j)

steps.claim: consts: ι ↦ |c(θ_ι)/c(1)|^(−2) has height at most 2·log b_D·𝓑(D): c costs m·m squares, i.e. height ≤ m²·2t·x⁹⁹⁹ (`Data.CostsSquares`, θ fit), and m²·2t·x⁹⁹⁹ ≤ 2·log b·𝓑 by the size comparison.
steps.lean:
have consts : HeightLe (2 * (D.logB * D.budget)) fun ι ↦ (‖c (θ ι) / c 1‖ ^ 2 :)⁻¹ :=
    (const θ o).mono (by simpa using D.le_of_hasLogBound) fun _ ↦ le_rfl
steps.typed_fact: HeightLe (2 * (D.logB * D.budget)) fun ι ↦ (‖c (θ ι) / c 1‖ ^ 2 :)⁻¹

steps.claim: (lifts)²·(consts)^(dim rows) has height ≤ 2·dim rows(log b𝓑 − h_main) + dim rows·2 log b𝓑 = 2·dim rows(D)·(2 log b_D·𝓑(D) − h_main(D)) (`HeightLe.pow`, `HeightLe.mul`), and it is the family 𝔷_D(1)²/𝔷_D(θ_ι)² by vol: 𝔷(1)²/𝔷(θ_ι)² = (∏_j λ_j(1)/λ_j(θ_ι))²·(|c(θ_ι)/c(1)|^(−2))^(dim rows).
steps.lean:
exact ((lifts.pow 2).mul (consts.pow D.rowDim)).mono (by grind) fun ι ↦
    (congrArg (‖ι.2 ·‖) (by simp [vol, mul_pow, div_pow, ← pow_mul]; ring)).le
